description: MCP profiler utility. profile_mcp(url)->dict: attempts to fetch the MCP server manifest or package.json. Extracts: tool_count, tool_names list, permission_list, server_type (npm/github/custom), has_authentication, has_encryption, declared_scope. Also runs url_analyser.analyse_url. Returns structured profile dict. Used as pre-assessment enrichment step before signal scoring. Handles timeout gracefully (5s). Stores profile in mcp_server_registry extended_metadata JSON field. No daemon.
